concepts.why: Patient has a 3-year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus and recent laboratory results show elevated plasma glucose and hemoglobin A1c levels.

Patient has a history of pancreatic swelling and elevated serum amylase and lipase levels, indicating chronic pancreatitis.
Patient has elevated serum IgG4 levels and pancreatic swelling, indicating autoimmune pancreatitis.
Patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus and laboratory results show elevated plasma glucose and hemoglobin A1c levels, indicating diabetic ketoacidosis.
